gloss: water column; water spout; pillar of water

definitions.gloss: water column; water spout; pillar of water
definitions.explanation: A column-shaped body of water rising vertically, such as a geyser eruption, a burst water main, or a waterspout. Also used as a unit of pressure measurement (millimeters of water column).

examples.japanese: {水柱|すいちゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: A column of water shot up high.

examples.japanese: ⟦{間欠泉|かんけつせん}→間欠泉：29597_kanketsusen⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{水柱|すいちゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{噴|ふ}き{出|だ}す→噴き出す：29265_fukidasu⟧⟦{瞬間|しゅんかん}→瞬間：03226_shunkan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{迫力|はくりょく}→迫力：14310_hakuryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The moment a water column erupts from the geyser is impressive.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水道管|すいどうかん}→水道管：08094_suidoukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{破裂|はれつ}→破裂：10058_haretsu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{真|ま}ん{中|なか}→真ん中：00968_mannaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{水柱|すいちゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}った→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: A water main burst, and a water column several meters high rose in the middle of the road.

notes:
Combines {水|すい} (water) and {柱|ちゅう} (pillar, column). Describes water shooting up in a vertical column shape. Commonly seen in news reports about broken water mains, volcanic eruptions near water, and natural phenomena like geysers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水柱|すいちゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧: a water column rises
- {水柱|すいちゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: a water column forms
- {水柱|すいちゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{噴|ふ}き{出|だ}す→噴き出す：29265_fukidasu⟧: a water column erupts
- ⟦ミリ→ミリ：28823_miri⟧{水柱|すいちゅう}: millimeters of water column (pressure unit)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{噴水|ふんすい}→噴水：09637_funsui⟧: fountain — an artificial, controlled water display
- ⟦{水中|すいちゅう}→水中：13310_suichuu⟧: underwater — a homophone with completely different meaning (⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ means "inside" not "pillar")
